title: Locale
description: JSON schema for locale. Based off the BCP-47 language tag, ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, and Olsen IANA time zone ID.

countryCode.title: Country Code
countryCode.description:
The [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code.
Note: The country code for Great Britain is GB and not UK as is used in that country's top-level domain names.
.
